questions.question_hindi: क्या पूरी तरह संविदा पर रखे गए कर्मचारी सामान्यतः CGHS सुविधाओं के पात्र होते हैं?
options_hindi: केवल संविदा पर नियुक्त कर्मचारियों को भी स्थायी कर्मचारियों जैसे सभी CGHS लाभ मिलते हैं
नहीं, संविदा कर्मचारी तब तक पात्र नहीं होते जब तक सरकार विशेष आदेश न दे

questions.question_english: Are purely contractual employees generally eligible for CGHS facilities?
options_english: Yes, purely contractual employees enjoy full CGHS benefits on par with permanent staff
No, contractual staff are ineligible unless specifically ordered by the Government
Yes, contractual staff are eligible, but coverage is strictly restricted to OPD care
Yes, contractual staff can obtain coverage provided they pay a 100% full premium fee
questions.explanation_english: No, contractual staff are ineligible unless specifically ordered by the Government. Regular scheme benefits are designed for permanent and temporary regular Central Civil employees and pensioners. Personnel engaged purely on contractual terms, daily wages, or consolidated fees fall outside regular scheme definitions and remain ineligible for scheme membership cards unless executive government orders specifically extend coverage to their contractual terms.
questions.explanation_hindi: सही उत्तर (B) है: नहीं, संविदा कर्मचारी तब तक पात्र नहीं होते जब तक सरकार विशेष आदेश न दे। स्रोत में दिए गए स्पष्टीकरण के अनुसार यही नियम, पात्रता-शर्त या प्रशासनिक प्रक्रिया इस प्रश्न पर लागू होती है।
key_facts: Answer key: (B)

questions.question_english: Can a widowed sister be included as a dependent family member on an employee’s medical card?
options_english: No, widowed sisters are never eligible
Yes, provided she is financially dependent on the employee and normally resides with them
Yes, regardless of income and place of residence

questions.explanation_english: Yes, provided she is financially dependent on the employee and normally resides with them. If the widowed sister resides continuously with the employee and her total monthly income from all sources does not exceed the statutory dependency ceiling limit, she can be enrolled on the employee’s card.

Whenever a new CMO I/C is administrative appointed at the wellness centre
On referral by the CMO I/C if diagnosis is ambiguous or complex care is needed

questions.explanation_english: On referral by the CMO I/C if diagnosis is ambiguous or complex care is needed. questions.question_english: What is the consequence if a serving employee submits a forged medical bill for reimbursement?

It constitutes grave misconduct, warranting disciplinary action and prosecution
The employee is issued an informal verbal warning by the Drawing and Disbursing Officer

questions.explanation_english: It constitutes grave misconduct, warranting disciplinary action and prosecution. Submitting fraudulent or forged medical claims, fake bills, or altered prescriptions constitutes grave financial misconduct and dishonesty under service rules. Such actions trigger formal disciplinary proceedings under Central Civil Services (Classification, Control and Appeal) Rules, potential dismissal from service, recovery of funds, and criminal prosecution.

questions.question_english: In the context of CGHS, what is the meaning of a “Non-Dieted” hospital?
options_english: A facility that enforces mandatory dietary fasting routines for patients admitted to inpatient wards
A specialized hospital dedicated exclusively to treating complex nutritional and eating disorders
A hospital without dietary facilities, where food charges are non-reimbursable
A hospital that provides complimentary imported clinical nutrition and dietary supplements to all
questions.explanation_english: A hospital without dietary facilities, where food charges are non-reimbursable. In medical terminology under scheme guidelines, a non-dieted hospital refers to an institution where daily patient meals are not provided as an integrated part of hospital care or package rates. In such hospitals, patient food expenditure is managed independently, and food charges are not admissible for financial reimbursement.

questions.question_english: In case of an absolute emergency, a CGHS beneficiary has the right to undergo treatment at:
options_english: Only designated public sector Government hospitals within the district
Only officially CGHS empanelled private hospitals in the region
Only municipal dispensaries and clinics managed by local civic bodies
Any hospital, including private un- empanelled medical institutions
